# Travelport search fixtures

Reduced GDS and NDC one-way and journey-based round-trip responses from Travelport's official [developer kits](https://developer.travelport.com/resources/devkits-and-downloads), downloaded 13 September 2026 (GDS v26.11.1 and NDC v25.11.2).

Only a few catalog offerings and their referenced products, flights, brands, and conditions remain. Irrelevant identifiers and price breakdowns were removed. Dates and pricing remain illustrative historic examples. These fixtures test the documented wire format and combinability rules; they do not establish account access or live inventory.
